newsitem.title: USA: Motorola says Q3 earnings may be below Q2.
newsitem.headline: Motorola says Q3 earnings may be below Q2.

text.p: Motorola Inc said Wednesday that sales and order patterns in July and August indicate that earnings for the third quarter may be significantly below those of the second quarter.
Third-quarter earnings also may be significantly below analysts' expectations, the company said.
In the second quarter Motorola earned $326 million, or $0.54 per share, on sales of $6.83 billion.
Analysts' consensus estimate for the third quarter is $0.50 a share, according to First Call.
Motorola's stock closed up 1/8 at 50-3/4 on Tuesday.

"The most significant factor vis-a-vis the second quarter is continuing weakness in pricing and unit demand in the semiconductor products sector as the semiconductor industry down-cycle continues," the company said.
Motorola predicted the third quarter would be the third consecutive quarter in which the semiconductor industry book-to-bill ratio is below than 1.0.

"In addition to a continuation of the pricing pressures reported in the second quarter in the cellular telephone, paging and modem businesses, sales and orders thus far in the third quarter have been weaker in international markets," the company said.
This weakness is affecting the paging and cellular telephone businesses and related component products, such as rechargeable batteries, it said.
Motorola said many of its businesses have implemented actions to reduce operating expenses, including hiring restrictions and reductions in work schedules and manufacturing run rates.
"We also have deferred capital expenditures, especially in the semiconductor products sector," it said.

"Despite the current difficult conditions in some of our major businesses, we remain confident that the global opportunities for our communications and semiconductor products remain as exciting as ever," it added.
The company scheduled a conference call for investment analysts at 0900 EDT/1300 GMT.
U.S. participants can access the call by dialing 1-800-424-9750. Participants outside the U.S. can call 1-312-864-5041.
Motorola expects to report on October 7 its results for the third quarter ended September 28.
